text:
lucy: Heads-up: rolling canary for release v2.14 to eu1 started. Quickcheck: prefix cache hit for synth probes down ~3% on canary vs baseline. Posting findings, cc @oncall_tim.

deploy-bot: roll id roll-8423 started; canary schedule 5% -> 20% over 30m. Dashboard: https://infradash/release/roll-8423

sam: seeing heartbeat delays in proxy around 16:02 UTC. Snippet: 
```
[16:02:14] proxy eu1-a: heartbeat delayed 280ms conn=xyz-12
[16:02:15] kvcache eu1-a: prefix-miss +72 events (window=60s)
```

anjali: Suggest we hold canary at 5% and run a quick prewarm + extended synth window (30s) to rule out cold-cache. Also propose pin model variant to v2.14-quant for canary while we observe.

lucy: @deploy-bot please hold rollout at 5% and disable auto-promotion. Add env DEBUG_PREFETCH=true on canary nodes.

deploy-bot: action: canary held at 5%, auto-promotion disabled. Env var flagging added to canary pods (roll-8423). Notifying infra team.

oncall_tim: I'll tail prometheus/traces. If prefix_miss_rate > 5% for 5m OR latency p95 increases by >50ms we rollback. ETA 10m to confirm.

qa-bot: synthetic run (run-998): 1m avg latency +12ms, prefix_miss +3.8% (baseline 0.5%).

sam: correlating with k8s event: eu1-b pod restarted at 16:03 due to image pull backoff; came back up and registered. Could be warm cache population causing temporary miss spike.

anjali: I'll trigger a prewarm job against canary (prefetch keys + small batch warm). Triggering prewarm job id prewarm-332 now.

lucy: capture prometheus query for monitoring: `sum(rate(prefix_miss[1m])) by (shard)` and alert if shard_value > 0.05.

anjali: prewarm-332 results: prefetch hit 78% after 30s, prefix_miss back down to ~0.9%. Logs: `prefetch_success=154, prefetch_total=198`.

oncall_tim: after prewarm, observed prefix_miss 0.9% and latency normalized to baseline. Recommend resume rollout to 20% and keep 10m watch.

lucy: Agreed. @deploy-bot resume rollout to 20% and monitor for 10m; rollback criteria as above. Thanks team :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollout resumed to 20%. Will post update at +10m or on anomaly.
